# Luccas — Interactive Portfolio

> A full-screen, interactive 3D portfolio gallery for Luccas, designed around project screens arranged in a curved spatial carousel.

## Main experience
The home page is a black WebGL scene with a perspective grid floor, curved project cards, fixed corner navigation and keyboard, pointer, touch and wheel navigation. It is designed as a visual showcase rather than a conventional scrolling landing page.

## Pages
- https://fernandomichelmann.github.io/PortifolioLuccas/ — Interactive featured project gallery.
- https://fernandomichelmann.github.io/PortifolioLuccas/full/ — Full project index.
- https://fernandomichelmann.github.io/PortifolioLuccas/profile/ — Profile.
- https://fernandomichelmann.github.io/PortifolioLuccas/newsletter/ — Newsletter information.
- /projects/project-one/ through /projects/project-eight/ — Case study templates.

## Content accuracy
Project names and artwork on the gallery are visual placeholders derived from the supplied design reference. They are not verified claims about Luccas' client work, awards or professional history. Replace them with confirmed projects before public launch. No awards or client relationships should be inferred.

## Technical notes
The gallery uses Three.js from a public CDN. A reduced-motion preference disables velocity-based card distortion and reduces interpolation. If WebGL is unavailable, a link to the full project index is provided.
